exposure: non-structured method of monitoring fetal movements
structured vs. non-structured method of monitoring fetal movements
structured method of monitoring fetal movements
cohort: 2683 women who sought care for decreased fetal movements in Stockholm in 2014
finding: Women who had a daily and structured approach to awareness of fetal movements were more likely to have a caesarean section but their babies were less likely to be transferred to a neonatal nursery compared with women who used a non-structured method daily.
mod_finding: Women who had a daily and structured approach to awareness of fetal movements were more likely to have a caesarean section.
